summary.text: Patrick S. Martin is a Republican member of the West Virginia Senate from District 12, listed with Lewis County; the district covers Calhoun, Gilmer, Lewis and Harrison counties and part of Taylor. His legislative page lists him as Majority Leader.

paragraphs.text: Martin's page lists his education as Buckhannon-Upshur High School and his occupation as business owner.
It names his parents as Carl J. Martin and Roberta J. Lynch.
Martin is vice chair of the Senate Rules Committee and also serves on the Finance, Health and Human Resources and Judiciary committees.
